title: Brand Name or Equal - Verathon GlideScope/ BFlex ecosystem (Dual View, single-use bronchoscopy/laryngoscopy)
agency_path: VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.261-NETWORK CONTRACT OFFICE 21 (36C261)
detail_text: The Department of Veterans Affairs, VA Northern California Health Care System (VANCHCS), is conducting market research to identify qualified sources capable of providing Brand Name or Equal airway visualization equipment compatible with clinical laryngoscopy and bronchoscopy needs. Required supplies include systems functionally equivalent to the GlideScope Core 15 System with Accessories and the GlideScope Go 2 Video Laryngoscopy System , used to support anesthesia and emergency airway management. All technical specifications, salient characteristics, response requirements, point‑of‑contact information , and submission instructions are provided in the attached document. Vendors should review the attachment in full and respond in accordance with the information requested therein. This Sources Sought Notice is for market research only and does not constitute a solicitation. Responses will assist in determining the appropriate procurement strategy.
